title: ENEOS Materials brings ChatGPT Enterprise to manufacturing
summary: ENEOS Materials uses ChatGPT Enterprise to speed research, improve plant design safety, and cut HR analysis time by 90%, with 80% reporting better workflows.
body: ENEOS Materials uses ChatGPT Enterprise to speed research, improve plant design safety, and cut HR analysis time by 90%, with 80% reporting better workflows.
summaryZh: ENEOS Materials通过部署ChatGPT Enterprise，显著提升了制造业的研发效率与生产安全。该应用在工厂设计安全评估及人力资源分析流程中表现突出，实现了90%的分析时间缩减，并有80%的员工反馈工作流得到优化，验证了大模型在工业场景中的实际生产力价值。

aiReview.reasonZh: ENEOS Materials的案例展示了企业级大模型在制造业研发与流程优化中的具体落地成效。
